        while q:
          y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]!=0 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
        objects.append(comp)
    motif=max(objects,key=len)

    pr0=min(r for r,c in palette_comp); pr1=max(r for r,c in palette_comp)
